description: To the payload corresponding JSON schema file is `NodeItem.json`

vendorOrProvider.description: interface vendor or provider name, should corresponds to name used as part of the **namespace** used for KNX vendor attributes

lastModified.description: Last modification of the installation, date/ time in ISO 8601/ RFC 3339 format, <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6>

currentDateTime.description: The current system time of the node, reflecting the time which the underlying system is using, date/ time in ISO 8601/ RFC 3339 format, <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6>

server.description: interface API version (of device or service resp. node, not the API)

maxSubscriptions.description: The maximal number of total subscriptions a node supports at a time (regardless of an implemented WebSocket and/or HTTP subscription)

currentSubscriptions.description: The current number of subscriptions a node supports at a time (regardless of an implemented WebSocket and/or HTTP subscription)
